resources.string: Instance Icon Maker
Auto-pick a colour and text from version, loader and mod count. Writes icon.png into the instance.
Instance Diff
Compare two instances: mods, resource packs, shaders, config. Answers "why does A work but B not".
Instance Health Score
Scan version file, memory, mod count and crash reports. Gives a 0-100 score and a problem list.
Launch History
Launch times, duration, per-instance counts and the last 20 sessions.
Auto-tag Mods
Sort mods into optimisation, building, tech, magic, adventure by filename keywords.
Locked Mods
Mark mods you do not want updated. Stored locally, per instance.
Mod Dependency Tree
Read each mod\'s own declared dependencies. Shows who needs whom and flags missing ones.
Mod Downgrade
Swap a mod for a version you placed in the mods folder. Backs up the original first.
Changelog Aggregator
Collect CHANGELOG files bundled inside each mod jar.
Resource Pack Preview
View block, item and GUI textures inside a resource pack without launching the game.
Shader Compatibility
Read the shaders/ folder and GLSL version to judge how new a renderer it needs.
Batch Rename
Find-and-replace or add prefix/suffix to mods, packs, shaders, worlds. Preview first.
Performance Baseline
Total launches, play time, crash rate and a per-instance comparison.
Download Source Speed Test
Test whether the official and BMCLAPI mirrors are reachable and how fast.
Auto-switch Download Source
Switch to the next mirror automatically on failure. Configurable retries.
Download Templates
Save the list of things a modpack needs, reuse it next time.
File Integrity Check
Scan jars for zero-byte, unreadable or broken files. Read-only.
Password Vault
Store server and room passwords. Stored in app-private storage - NOT encrypted (stated in the UI).
Action Log
Records write operations performed by plugins, so you can trace them.
Merge Resource Packs
Merge two resource pack zips. Same-named files take the top layer. Originals kept.
Theme Editor
Switch the launcher accent colour (8 choices). Takes effect immediately.
Server Ping
Measure TCP connect latency to a list of servers before joining.
Glossary
Maintain an "English to preferred translation" table for consistent wording.
Tutorial Library
Six offline tutorials: install, mods, multiplayer, server, modpack, troubleshooting.
Server Setup Wizard
Generate server.properties and a start script. Phone servers are slow - better for making configs.
Import Instances
Import instances from HMCL, PCL2, official launcher or MultiMC. Copies only.
Launch Splash
Show a solid colour or progress bar while the game starts.
Launch Queue
Remember the order you want to launch instances in.
Mod Update Pre-check
Local pre-check: find duplicates and locked mods. Checking for new versions needs the internet.
Shader Presets
List shader packs and remember which one you use. Enabling still happens in-game.
Java Auto-match
Read the javaVersion field in the version JSON and compare with installed runtimes.
JVM Argument Presets
Four JVM argument presets: low-end, smooth, large memory, debug.
World Map Preview
Read region chunk tables and draw which chunks have been generated.
World Edit Guard
A checklist before touching worlds, plus each world\'s size.
Server Whitelist
View whitelist, ops and banned files.
Offline Wiki
15 vanilla quick-reference entries: diamond, netherite, ender pearl, villager trading and more.
Data Migration
Pack settings, stats, notes and glossary into one zip to move to a new phone.
Game Rule Presets
Survival, creative, PvP, redstone, building, skyblock - writes a datapack into the world.
World Version Warning
Compare each world\'s MC version with the current instance and warn on mismatch.
World Players
List player data files in a world: UUID, last modified, size. Read-only.
Quick Notes
Store server IPs, coordinates and to-dos. Pinned, local, never uploaded.
Factory Reset
Reset launcher settings. Never deletes instances, worlds or accounts.
Language / 语言
Switch the launcher UI language (17 languages).
